message.content:
I can see the vulnerability. In `mpz_get_int`, the code accesses `y->p[1]` without checking if `y->sz >= 2`. The `dg` macro safely checks bounds, but `mpz_get_int` directly accesses `y->p[1]`. If a bigint has `sz == 1` (only one limb allocated), accessing `y->p[1]` reads past the allocation.

Let me look at how bigints are created and how comparisons work to understand how to trigger this.
